training_seed_binding: Each trained candidate is evaluated only against the PF_DENSE_REFERENCE model trained with the same postflop training_seed. Held-out state generation and crossplay are repeated for every frozen training_seed × paired_evaluation_seed cell.

stable_rng_derivation.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 text fields joined by ASCII vertical bar with prefix SpinCore|R7.5.4A|REFV1
stable_rng_derivation.integer_seed: unsigned little-endian integer from the first 8 bytes of SHA256 digest
stable_rng_derivation.rule: Candidate identity is never an RNG input. A lexical candidate-pair id may be used only for a paired bootstrap stream after both candidate sample arrays already exist; it cannot affect poker-state/deal/action/continuation generation.

exact_action_identity.rule: Dense-referee omission compares exact actions, not nominal universal slots. Two nominal sizings that resolve to the same exact action are one action; a candidate is credited with availability whenever any of its effective slots resolves to the same exact identity.

heldout_referee_states.state_source_policy: PF_DENSE_REFERENCE AveragePolicy from the matching training_seed
heldout_referee_states.scenario_cycle: exact R7.4 cycle, hand_index modulo scenario_count
heldout_referee_states.collection: Start a fresh exact hand for each hand_index, follow the dense referee policy using deterministic keyed uniforms, and append every nonterminal decision state in chronological order until exactly 2048 states are retained. If a hand would exceed the target, retain only the prefix needed to reach 2048.
stored_replay_descriptor: ordered effective universal slot path from root to state

dense_referee_omission.utility: ICM_EXACT_V1 payout delta for the actor at the held-out decision state
dense_referee_omission.referee_action_set: all unique exact actions from PF_DENSE_REFERENCE effective post-dedup legal set at the state
dense_referee_omission.candidate_available_set: intersection by exact-action identity between candidate effective post-dedup actions and referee exact actions
dense_referee_omission.q_definition: Apply one exact referee action child, then evaluate frozen partial-exact continuation under PF_DENSE_REFERENCE for every future player.
dense_referee_omission.omission_per_state: max(Q over all referee exact actions) - max(Q over candidate-available referee exact actions)
dense_referee_omission.candidate_missing_all_referee_actions: hard evaluator error; impossible because CHECK_CALL/FOLD/ALL_IN controls must retain at least one common effective exact action when legal

continuation.target_player_future_nodes: enumerate all effective PF_DENSE actions and probability-weight by dense-referee AveragePolicy
continuation.opponent_nodes_after_exact_levels: sample one effective action from dense-referee AveragePolicy
continuation.chance: already fixed by the exact hand/deck state
continuation.common_random_numbers: For a given state and exact root action, all candidate evaluations reuse the same keyed continuation stream because candidate_id is absent.

bootstrap.resample: sample state indices with replacement, preserving candidate/referee pairing

crossplay.reference: all seats use PF_DENSE_REFERENCE AveragePolicy from the matching training_seed
crossplay.candidate_test: one physical seat uses candidate AveragePolicy; every other seat uses matching PF_DENSE_REFERENCE
crossplay.score: candidate-seat terminal ICM_EXACT_V1 delta in candidate test minus same physical seat terminal ICM_EXACT_V1 delta in all-referee reference hand

cross_seed_policy_stability.source: deterministic stratified observations from each seed's final Strategy reservoir, keeping observation bytes and ten-action legal mask together
cross_seed_policy_stability.metric: total variation distance between candidate AveragePolicy distributions under the same exact observation/legal mask

root_level_semantics.160: prune-only; no final action abstraction selection
root_level_semantics.320: minimum level eligible for final selection if frozen evidence cascade resolves
root_level_semantics.640: mandatory escalation when 320 does not resolve under the precommitted cascade

forbidden: change evaluation RNG derivation after seeing candidate outputs
compare candidate/referee by nominal slot id instead of exact action identity
generate held-out states from the candidate being scored
use different deals or policy uniforms for candidate and all-referee crossplay reference
drop a bad domain/training seed/evaluation seed cell
reduce held-out states, crossplay hands, bootstrap replicates, or training seeds because runtime is inconvenient
use R7.5.4 GitHub timing as physical R8 trainability PASS
